summary.intent: Fix a release-please misconfiguration that was blocking tag creation for v0.25.1 after a multi-package setup was introduced.
summary.outcome: The root cause was identified (missing `${component}` in `pull-request-title-pattern`), a fix was committed on a `chore(ci)` branch, and v0.25.1 was manually tagged to unblock staging.

repo: cipher-box uses release-please with a multi-package config; the root package is 'cipher-box' and there are component packages like '@cipherbox/core'.

The release-please-config.json had `pull-request-title-pattern: 'chore: release'` without `${component}`, which causes release-please to fail to match merged release PRs back to their components in a monorepo setup.
The .release-please-manifest.json already reflected version 0.25.1 after PR #306 merged, meaning release-please bumped versions but aborted before creating the tag/GitHub release.
release-please aborts with 'untagged, merged release PRs outstanding' when it cannot reconcile a previously merged release PR (PR #298) to a component due to the missing title pattern variable.

code.finding: pull-request-title-pattern was missing `${component}`, causing component matching to fail for merged PRs in multi-package mode.

workflow: When release-please is stuck due to an unrecognized merged release PR, manually tagging the release version allows unblocking staging while the config fix is landed.
After merging a release-please PR, verify that both component tags (e.g., @cipherbox/core-v0.25.0) AND a root GitHub Release/tag are created — their absence indicates an abort condition.
Checking workflow run logs for the release-please action is the fastest way to diagnose why a tag was not created after a release PR merge.

friction: release-please silently aborted tag creation without a visible failure — the merged PR #306 appeared successful but produced no tag, requiring log investigation to find the abort message.
The misconfiguration in pull-request-title-pattern was introduced at some earlier point when multi-package support was added, and went undetected until a release cycle failed.
open_items: The chore(ci) branch with the pull-request-title-pattern fix needs to be reviewed, merged, and CI validated.
PR #298's status with release-please should be monitored after the config fix lands to confirm it no longer triggers the 'untagged merged release PR' abort.
Staging deployment using the manually created v0.25.1 tag (via 'Tag Staging Release' workflow) still needs to be run.
